title: Jumbo Jalapeno Spanish Cheese Paella
description: A savory, cheese-pull, solo-dinner Spanish dish featuring passion fruit pulp, slow-cooked to perfection in a bamboo steamer, vegan-friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bamboo steamer over medium heat.
Add the diced jalapeno peppers and cook until they start to soften.
Add the smoked paprika and saffron threads, stirring constantly for 1 minute.
Add the brown rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the vegetable broth, passion fruit pulp, and shredded vegan cheese, stirring until the cheese is well combined.
Cover the bamboo steamer with a lid and transfer it to a low heat setting.
Slow cook the paella for 25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the paella from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
